page.layout: One page of title text, centred, with an ornamental cartouche (engraving) below the text block. Handwriting, library stamp and shelf mark are not transcribed.
page.notes: The engraved ornament (cartouche) lies between the text and the imprint and carries no legible text. The handwritten "Bedford" and the shelf mark "1.9.45" are not printed text and are omitted. The Bodleian library stamp is omitted. The word "Knatchbull" is partly obscured in the scan; "KNATCHBULL" is read from the visible letters. "Ric. Davis" and "Henricus Hall" are partly obscured and may need checking against the original.
